_note: Known contradictions in the subset, each checked in docs/ (see SOURCES.md), against the recorded Muse extraction in candidates.json (muse-spark-1.3, 2026-11-03). found_by: 'extraction' = both facts come from the recording once a person accepts them; 'authored' = a reader adds the facts with Add fact (the recording does not state them as a detail). The gold plan (scripts/sherlock-probe.mjs): accept every verified candidate, scan (W1 only, no false alarm), add the authored facts (N1, L1), merge Watson's wife into Mary (M1), scan again.

statements: Watson's wound is on his shoulder.
Watson's wound is in his leg.

quotes.quote: There I was struck on the shoulder by a Jezail bullet, which shattered the bone and grazed the subclavian artery.
I made no remark, however, but sat nursing my wounded leg.

conflicts.why: The same Jezail bullet from Maiwand: in the shoulder in A Study in Scarlet, in the leg in The Sign of the Four ("I had a Jezail bullet through it some time before").

quotes.quote: Being a reprint from the Reminiscences of JOHN H. WATSON, M.D.
Or should you rather that I sent James off to bed?

conflicts.why: The narrator is John H. Watson; in The Man with the Twisted Lip his wife calls him James.

quotes.quote: I could hear Mrs. Hudson, our landlady, raising her voice in a wail of expostulation and dismay
When Mrs. Turner has brought in the tray I will make it clear to you. Now,” he said as he turned hungrily on the simple fare that our landlady had provided

conflicts.why: In A Scandal in Bohemia a Mrs. Turner serves the meal "our landlady" provided; everywhere else the landlady is Mrs. Hudson.

quotes.quote: My mother was dead, and I had no relative in England.
My wife was on a visit to her mother’s, and for a few days I was a dweller once more in my old quarters at Baker Street.

after_merge.why: Holds only once a person decides Watson's wife in The Five Orange Pips is Mary Morstan; the merge is that decision. Sherlockians use this slip to argue for an earlier wife. Both facts are authored: the recording states neither Mary's mother nor Watson's wife, and "Mary" is the name it files Mary Morstan under.

dropped.why: Left arm vs leg: the recording has no fact for Holmes's "His left arm has been injured" (A Study in Scarlet, I.2), so canon never says left arm.
Shoulder vs "a weak leg" after merging Dr. Watson into Watson: the recording extracts nothing from that passage (The Sign of the Four, 2) and never files a "Dr. Watson", so there is no page to merge.
Left arm vs "a weak leg" after the same merge: neither side is in the recording.
Shoulder vs left arm, the old expected false alarm: without a left-arm fact the first scan raises W1 and nothing else, so there is no false alarm to dismiss.
